feature_name: Shelter source enrichment and confirmation queue
job: Turn already-collected public adoption-page evidence into a cited, human-reviewable shelter data record and a one-time confirmation-email draft.

user.free_access: Not a public feature; an authorized Pawline operator must review every candidate and explicitly approve any email.

schema.candidateId: UUID of a queued public web-discovery candidate
schema.consentToAiProcessing: boolean true; confirms only the stored public title, snippet, source URL, city, and species hint may be sent
schema.humanReviewed: boolean true before a contact or email draft can be approved

schema.candidateData: cited organization, source, listing/feed, coverage, freshness, terms, attribution, and contact-candidate fields
schema.uncertainties: array of 0-10 missing or unverified fields
schema.emailDraft: deterministic confirmation draft only after human review

response.boundary: Review every extracted field and the email draft before contacting a shelter; neither output verifies a source or publishes a listing.

allowed: public HTTPS source URL and domain
city and species hint attached to the discovery lead
prohibited: decisions to publish or activate a listing

claims.landing_page: Pawline can prepare a cited shelter-source review record and a confirmation-email draft from public discovery evidence.
